instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: NovaSolutions is a B2B SaaS provider specializing in project management and data analytics tools for mid-sized enterprises. They operate primarily online, handling scalable cloud infrastructure with minimal direct regulatory oversight.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has recently launched two minor feature updates based on user feedback but does not have a structured pipeline for major new product development or market entry strategies.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to reduce reliance on the existing domestic enterprise market by successfully entering two adjacent geographical regions and identifying three completely new vertical industries.
answers.teamSize: The core R&D team consists of 15 engineers and product managers, working collaboratively but lacking dedicated cross-functional innovation roles.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently prioritizing stability and predictable growth over aggressive market disruption.

opportunities.title: Vertical Feature Expansion (Adjacent Market Entry)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing core competency to target a completely new industry vertical, such as logistics or professional services, provides low-risk diversification. This uses current technical skills and minimizes brand risk.

first_actions: Identify three potential adjacent verticals (e.g., HR Tech, Field Service Management).
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) framework for one identified vertical.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5 paying pilot customers in the new vertical within Q3.
milestones: Market validation report completed by end of Month 1.
MVP feature set launch and feedback loop established.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnership for Market Access
opportunities.rationale: Instead of internal expansion, NovaSolutions can diversify by forming strategic alliances with established players who already dominate new geographic or vertical markets. This lowers competitive pressure and speeds up entry.

first_actions: Audit top 5 potential partnership targets based on revenue/market share.
Develop a tailored pitch package focusing on complementary technology.
resources_needed: Executive time allocation for relationship building
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one formal strategic partnership agreement within 9 months.
milestones: Finalize MoU with a target partner.

opportunities.title: Core Platform Re-architecture for Scalability
opportunities.rationale: To support future diversification goals, the current monolithic architecture needs a radical overhaul to allow rapid deployment of new vertical features. This is high risk but necessary if they wish to pursue high-growth markets.

first_actions: Conduct technical feasibility study for microservices transition.
Establish a dedicated internal 'Innovation Task Force'.
resources_needed: Increased budget allocation (requires 10% temporary dip in operational spend)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average feature deployment time by 40%.
milestones: Successful migration of core services to cloud-native microservices framework.

next_steps.action: Launch a formal cross-departmental 'Adjacent Market Feasibility Study' led by the leadership team.
Identify and initiate contact with three potential strategic partnership targets in new verticals.
Complete the technical feasibility assessment for microservices transition to support radical opportunities.

key_weaknesses: Informal process lacks structured pipeline visibility.
High reliance on current core product, limiting diversification potential.
Talent gap in dedicated innovation and cross-functional roles.
Lack of formalized market validation methodology.
